title: Practice: Chemical Reactions in the Environment
description: Low-stakes practice on combustion, acids on metals, acids on carbonates, and acid rain damage.

questions.question: Which word equation best represents complete combustion of a hydrocarbon fuel?
options: fuel + oxygen -> carbon dioxide + water + energy
acid + carbonate -> salt + water + carbon dioxide
questions.explanation: Complete combustion of a hydrocarbon uses oxygen and produces carbon dioxide, water, and energy as heat and often light.

questions.question: Vinegar is poured on crushed eggshell and bubbles form. Which gas is most likely produced?
questions.explanation: Eggshell contains calcium carbonate. Acids react with carbonates to produce a salt, water, and carbon dioxide gas.

questions.question: True or False: Acid rain can slowly damage marble or limestone because these materials contain carbonate compounds.
questions.explanation: True. Acid reacts with carbonate materials such as limestone and marble, slowly dissolving or etching their surfaces.

questions.question: An acid reacts with zinc metal. What is the expected product pattern?
questions.explanation: Many acids react with active metals to form a salt and hydrogen gas. Bubbles may be observed as the hydrogen gas forms.

questions.question: In complete combustion, the gas linked to climate change that is commonly produced is ____.
questions.explanation: Complete combustion of carbon-containing fuels produces carbon dioxide, a greenhouse gas linked to climate change.

questions.question: True or False: Combustion is useful only in laboratories and does not occur in daily life.
questions.explanation: False. Combustion occurs in daily life when LPG, charcoal, gasoline, diesel, or other fuels burn.

questions.question: Why can coastal metal roofs or railings corrode faster than similar objects kept indoors?
questions.correctAnswer: Coastal metal objects are exposed to moisture, oxygen, and salt spray, and acidic pollutants may also speed corrosion. Indoor objects usually have less exposure to these factors.
questions.explanation: Corrosion is faster when metals are exposed to water, oxygen, salts, and acids. Coastal environments often provide several of these conditions at once.

questions.question: Which observation best suggests acid reacting with a carbonate material?
options: A solid melts into liquid metal
A clear liquid evaporates with no residue
Fizzing occurs and carbon dioxide is produced
questions.explanation: Acid + carbonate reactions release carbon dioxide gas, which appears as fizzing or bubbles.
